about_the_game:
Background

"Have you ever wondered—what if Utopia truly existed in this world, and you happened to catch a glimpse of it?"

"And now, the gates of Utopia stand right before you—"

In this game, you will play as a child named Tiwn, who receives the chance to journey to the northern land of Utopia together with his younger sister Tis.

However, the path to Utopia is not as easy as you might imagine...

You will soon discover that the true "key" to reaching Utopia may not be a fairy from a tale, but perhaps... something else?

Game Content

This game is a fairy tale-style, story-driven side-scrolling RPG. You will take on the role of Tiwn and embark on a journey to Utopia alongside his sister Tis. Progress is made by exploring, investigating, and engaging in dialogue, ultimately unlocking multiple endings.

The game features: multiple playthroughs, multiple endings, slight meta elements, mild depictions of blood and violence, and scenes with flashing effects. If you feel uncomfortable while playing, please stop immediately and seek help from others.

Total endings: Currently planned at 6 endings, including 4 normal endings and 2 special ones. The final release may feature more or fewer endings depending on suitability.

Basic Controls:

  • WASD: Move

  • Z / SPACE: Confirm

  • X: Cancel / Open Menu

short_description: In this fairy tale-style RPG, you play as Tiwn, a child who sets out for "Utopia" with his sister Tis. But upon arrival, the gates are locked due to a missing key. Will the fairy of Utopia help you open them—or will someone else hold the answer?
